en.quote: Mandatory conscription into military service will be abolished in Russia in 2010.
en.head: Compulsory conscription continued after 2010.
en.body: Compulsory conscription was not abolished in 2010. It continued later: a law effective in 2024 raised the upper conscription age from 27 to 30. That confirms the system’s persistence, while the key test is that it was still in place in the promised year.
